title: ScaleDoc: Scaling LLM-based Predicates over Large Document Collections
bound_sents: To filter out high-confidence instances, the cascade component should select two thresholds, a lower bound $l$ and an upper bound $r$.

We define this fraction as the unfiltered rate $u$, controlled by the lower bound and upper bound: [display] The final accuracy, Acc $(l, r)$, is determined by the correctness of the lightweight model in the filtered regions, combined with the perfect accuracy of the oracle on the unfiltered region  …
Here, $l_0$ is the tightest (highest) lower bound possible when the upper bound is most conservative ($r_s$), and $r_0$ is the lowest upper bound when the lower bound is most conservative ($l_s$).
